_meta.notes: Root Sight two-mode camera, soil cutaway, and reroot substrate multiplier

cutaway_radius.notes: Radius of the underground cutaway sphere around the camera target

transition_ms.notes: Smooth transition duration between surface and underground modes (0 = instant)

soil_opacity.notes: Opacity of soil inside the cutaway (0 = invisible, 0.9 = nearly opaque)

own_root_highlight_color.notes: High-contrast color for the viewer's own roots

rival_root_highlight_color.notes: Distinct color for nearby rival roots

substrate_multiplier.notes: Movement multiplier for uprooted reroot crawl (T06); applies whether Root Sight is on or off

camera_target.notes: Default cutaway target reference; the camera is an independent entity
